probes.title: Tuples
probes.task: A function returns 1 and "a" together as a tuple. The caller unpacks them and prints both.

probes.title: Refusing a record with a missing field
probes.task: Config has the fields timeout and retries, with no defaults. The program builds a Config with both and prints them. The compiler refuses a Config that leaves out retries.

probes.title: Sum type with a checked match
probes.task: Shape is either Circle(r) or Square(side), and the compiler refuses a match that leaves out Square. The program prints the name of Circle(1).

probes.title: Optional value
probes.task: A value may be missing, and the compiler refuses a read without a check. The program prints "none" for a missing one.

probes.title: Distinct types with the same storage
probes.task: Meters and Seconds both store a 64-bit float, and the compiler refuses to add one to the other. The program prints 2 m + 3 m.

probes.title: Refusing an integer where an enum is expected
probes.task: Color is Red, Green or Blue, and name(c) returns its name. The program prints name(Green). The compiler refuses name(7).

probes.title: Refusing an override that overrides nothing
probes.task: Circle replaces Shape's describe() method, and the program prints describe() of a Circle used as a Shape: circle. The compiler refuses a method in Circle marked as a replacement (override, a trait or interface implementation) whose misspelled name, descibe, matches nothing in Shape.

probes.title: Duration type
probes.task: The program adds 1.5 s and 500 ms as durations and prints the total in milliseconds. The compiler refuses adding a plain number to a duration.

probes.title: Refusing null in a plain reference
probes.task: The program builds a Config named "app" and prints its name. The compiler refuses setting a plain (not optional) Config variable to null.

probes.title: Refusing a read before every path sets a variable
probes.task: The program declares a variable, sets it on every path, and prints it. The compiler refuses a version that reads a variable only one path sets, or refuses a declaration with no value at all.

probes.title: Refusing an unguarded shared write
probes.task: Two threads each add an item to one shared growable list, under a lock or by handing the item back. The compiler refuses a version where a thread adds to the list with no lock. The program prints the list's length.

probes.title: Lock that owns its data
probes.task: A standard lock holds a record with two fields, and the compiler refuses a read of a field without the lock. Two threads each add 1 to both fields 1,000 times under the lock. The program prints both fields.

probes.title: Array that copies on assignment
probes.task: a is a mutable fixed-size array [1, 2, 3]. The program sets b = a, changes b[0] to 9 in place, and prints a[0].

probes.title: List the program cannot change
probes.task: The program creates a list of 3 items that the type system keeps fixed, and the compiler refuses a change to it. The program prints its length.

probes.title: Refusing a write to a read-only argument
probes.task: A function receives a list it must only read and returns its length. The compiler refuses a write to the list inside the function.

probes.title: Record that copies on assignment
probes.task: a is a mutable record with x = 1. The program sets b = a, changes b.x to 9 in place, and prints a.x.

probes.title: Refusing a second assignment to a constant
probes.task: The program binds x = 1 with the language's constant form (let, val, const, final) and prints it. The compiler refuses x = 2.

probes.title: Refusing use after a value is consumed
probes.task: close(h) takes ownership of a handle. The compiler refuses any use of the handle after that call. The program prints "closed".

probes.title: Refusing two mutable references to one value
probes.task: transfer(from, to, amount) changes both arguments. The program moves 30 from a (100) to b (0) and prints both. The compiler refuses a call that passes a as both arguments.

probes.title: Memory freed without a free call
probes.task: The program allocates 4,000,000 records of 1 KB on the heap in a loop, keeps only the last, and prints its id, 3999999. Nothing in the program frees memory: garbage collection, reference counting or ownership reclaims each record once nothing uses it. The loop allocates 4 GB in all, more than the 3 GB limit, so memory that is never reclaimed fails the probe.

probes.title: Errors as return values
probes.task: parse_port("x") returns either the port or a typed error, in a return type the language checks: a result type, an error union, a union or sum type (from the library or declared in the program), or a value-and-error pair. The caller handles both cases and prints "error". Exceptions, a bare success flag and unchecked type hints do not count.

probes.title: Refusing an ignored error
probes.task: The compiler refuses a call to save() that ignores its error result, with a build error or a must-use diagnostic. The program then handles the error and prints "handled".

probes.title: Catching one kind of error
probes.task: A function handles error kind A and lets kind B pass to its caller. The program prints "caught A", then "passed B".

probes.title: Cleanup on every path
probes.task: The program releases a resource on both the success and the error path, with the release written once (RAII, defer, using, with, finally), and prints "released" for each of two calls.

probes.title: Cleanup during a panic
probes.task: A function's cleanup runs while a panic or exception leaves it. The top level recovers and exits with status 0. The program prints "cleanup", then "recovered".

probes.title: Assertions
probes.task: The program prints "before", then asserts false with the language's assertion. It must stop with a nonzero status.

probes.title: Refusing a value that is never used
probes.task: The program computes total = price + 2 and prints it. The compiler refuses a local variable that is set and never read.

probes.title: Refusing a function that can end without a result
probes.task: grade(score) returns a value on every path, and the program prints grade(60). The compiler refuses a function where one path ends without returning.

probes.title: Unsigned 64-bit integers
probes.task: The program stores 2^64 - 1 in an unsigned 64-bit integer and prints it.

probes.title: 128-bit integers
probes.task: The program stores 2^100 in a fixed-size 128-bit integer and prints it.

probes.title: Refusing a literal that does not fit
probes.task: The program stores 100 in an 8-bit integer and prints it. The compiler refuses the literal 300 for the same type.

probes.title: Refusing a silent narrowing conversion
probes.task: The program converts a 64-bit integer variable holding 42 to a 32-bit integer explicitly and prints it. The compiler refuses the same assignment without the conversion.

probes.title: Refusing a signed/unsigned comparison
probes.task: The program compares -1 with an unsigned length of 3 after converting one side, and prints "less". The compiler refuses the comparison without the conversion.

probes.title: Threads that share memory
probes.task: Two threads fill the two halves of one shared 10-slot array with the numbers 0 to 9. After both finish, the program prints the sum.

probes.title: Mutex
probes.task: Two threads each add 1 to a shared counter 100,000 times, holding the standard mutex for each step. The program prints the total.

probes.title: Atomic counter
probes.task: Two threads each add 1 to a shared counter 100,000 times with an atomic add. The program prints the total.

probes.title: Channel
probes.task: A worker sends 1, 2 and 3 through the standard channel or blocking queue. The main thread receives and prints them.

probes.title: Background task
probes.task: The program starts a task that sleeps 50 ms and returns 7, prints "started" without waiting, then waits for the task and prints its result.

probes.title: Seeing a worker's failure
probes.task: A worker fails with "bad input" the language's usual way. The main thread waits for it and prints the failure.

probes.title: Waiting with a timeout
probes.task: The program waits at most 100 ms for a task that takes 5 s, prints "timed out", and exits without waiting for the task.

probes.title: Cancelling a task
probes.task: The program starts a task that loops until cancelled, cancels it, waits until it stops, and prints "stopped".

probes.title: Map that threads can share
probes.task: Four threads each add 1,000 different keys to one map from the standard library that needs no outside lock. The program prints the size.

probes.title: Running a program without a shell
probes.task: The program runs echo with the single argument "hi; touch /tmp/bb_x", passed as an argument list with no shell, and prints its output.

probes.title: Reading a child's exit status
probes.task: The program runs false and prints its exit status.

probes.title: Missing environment variable
probes.task: The program looks up the unset variable BB_UNSET with a call that tells "not set" apart from "empty", and prints "absent".

probes.title: Shutting down cleanly on SIGTERM
probes.task: The program handles SIGTERM, sends SIGTERM to itself, runs its cleanup, prints "cleaned up" and exits with status 0.

probes.title: Creating a temporary file safely
probes.task: The program creates a new temporary file or folder in one call that cannot collide with another process, writes "ok" to a file in it, reads it back and prints it.

probes.title: Creating a private file
probes.task: The program creates a file that only its owner can read and write (mode 600) and prints its permission bits in octal.

probes.title: Stopping a child that runs too long
probes.task: The program starts sleep 10 as a child process, stops it after 100 ms, waits for it to end, and prints "killed".

probes.title: Regular expressions
probes.task: The program matches ^[a-z]+[0-9]{2}$ against "abc12" and "abc1" and prints both results.

probes.title: Regex that cannot run away
probes.task: The program matches ^(a+)+$ against 34 a's followed by "!" and prints "no match" within 5 s.

probes.title: Characters as people see them
probes.task: The program takes the first 9 characters, as a reader counts them, of "abcdefgh👍🏽xyz" and prints them.

probes.title: Unicode normalization
probes.task: The program normalizes "e" plus U+0301 to NFC, compares it with U+00E9, and prints "equal".

probes.title: Strict UTF-8 decoding
probes.task: The program decodes the bytes 0x61 0xFF as UTF-8 so that bad bytes report an error instead of turning into replacement characters, and prints "invalid".

probes.title: Escaping text for HTML
probes.task: The program escapes Tom & Jerry for HTML with a library call and prints the result.

probes.title: Parsing JSON
probes.task: The program parses {"port": 8080, "debug": true} with a library call and prints the port, then parses {port: 8080}, gets an error, and prints "invalid".

probes.title: Addition that reports overflow
probes.task: The program adds 1 to the largest 64-bit integer, read at run time, with the overflow reported as a value or an error it can catch, and prints "overflow".

probes.title: Addition that wraps on purpose
probes.task: The program adds 1 to the largest 64-bit integer, read at run time, with explicit wraparound, and prints the result.

probes.title: Addition that stops at the limit
probes.task: The program adds 1 to the largest 64-bit integer, read at run time, with explicit saturation, and prints the result.

probes.title: Integers of any size
probes.task: The program computes 2^100 exactly and prints it.

probes.title: Decimal numbers
probes.task: The program adds 0.1 and 0.2 as decimals, compares the sum with 0.3, and prints "equal".

probes.title: Narrowing that reports failure
probes.task: The program converts 300, read at run time, to an unsigned 8-bit integer, with the failure reported as a value or an error it can catch, and prints "does not fit".

probes.title: Float to integer that reports failure
probes.task: The program converts NaN to a 64-bit integer, with the failure reported as a value or an error it can catch, and prints "does not fit".

probes.title: Strict number parsing
probes.task: The program parses "12abc" as an integer, gets a failure back, and prints "invalid".

probes.title: Sorted map
probes.task: The program inserts the keys c, a and b into a map that keeps keys in order, and prints the keys.

probes.title: Sorted set
probes.task: The program inserts 3, 1 and 2 into a set that keeps items in order, and prints them.

probes.title: Map that keeps insertion order
probes.task: The program inserts the keys c, a and b into a map that keeps them in the order added, and prints the keys.

probes.title: Double-ended queue
probes.task: The program adds 1 at the back, 0 at the front and 2 at the back, then takes one item off each end and prints them.

probes.title: Priority queue
probes.task: The program pushes 3, 1 and 2 into a min-heap, then pops and prints all of them.

probes.title: Counting map
probes.task: The program counts the words a, b, a with a counting map or bag type and prints the counts in key order.

probes.title: Bit set
probes.task: The program sets bit 1000 in a compact bit set, tests bits 1000 and 999, and prints both results.

probes.title: Pair as a set key
probes.task: The program puts the pair (1, 2) in a set as one key compared by value, checks for (1, 2), and prints the result.

probes.title: Index lookup that can miss
probes.task: The program reads index 5 of [10, 20, 30] with a lookup that returns a missing value (an optional, null or nil) instead of failing, and prints "none".

probes.title: Sorting floats in a total order
probes.task: The program sorts [3, NaN, 1, 2] with the standard comparison that puts every float, NaN included, in order, and prints the values with NaN written as "NaN".

probes.title: Time zones
probes.task: The program converts 2026-03-29 01:30 UTC to local time in Europe/Paris, just after the switch to summer time, and prints it.

probes.title: Growable byte buffer
probes.task: The program appends 100,000 bytes one at a time to a growable byte buffer and prints its length.

probes.title: Weak reference
probes.task: The program holds a weak reference to an object, drops the last strong reference (forcing a collection where needed), and prints "gone" once the weak reference no longer reaches the object.

probes.title: Error with a cause
probes.task: The program wraps the error "not found" with the context "loading config", prints the message, then reads the original cause back from the wrapper and prints it.

probes.title: Stack trace as a value
probes.task: Function inner captures the call stack as a value. The program prints "inner" if the trace names it.

probes.title: Surviving a crashed worker
probes.task: A worker panics or throws. The main thread keeps running, prints "worker crashed" and exits with status 0.

probes.title: Handling a failed allocation
probes.task: The program asks for 10^13 bytes, read from the command line, handles the failure, and prints "allocation failed".

probes.title: Handling a stack overflow
probes.task: Runaway recursion becomes an error the program handles. It prints "stack overflow" and exits with status 0.

probes.title: Last-chance error handler
probes.task: The program registers a handler that runs for any unhandled error before the process exits, then fails without handling the error. The handler prints "hook ran".

probes.title: Checking a path stays in its folder
probes.task: The program joins /srv/app with ../../etc/passwd, normalizes the result, checks whether it stays under /srv/app, and prints "outside".

probes.title: Constant-time comparison
probes.task: The program compares two equal 16-byte secrets with a constant-time function and prints "equal".

probes.title: Cryptographic randomness
probes.task: The program reads 16 bytes from a cryptographic random source and prints them in hex.

probes.title: SHA-256
probes.task: The program hashes "abc" with SHA-256 and prints the hex digest.

probes.title: Hashing a password
probes.task: The program hashes the password "hunter2" with a slow password hash (PBKDF2, bcrypt, scrypt or Argon2), checks "hunter2" and "wrong" against it, and prints both results.

probes.title: Signing a message with HMAC
probes.task: The program computes HMAC-SHA256 of "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog" with the key "key" and prints the tag in hex.

probes.title: Authenticated encryption
probes.task: The program encrypts "secret" with AES-GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305 under a random key and nonce, decrypts it and prints it, then flips one bit of the ciphertext and prints "rejected" when decryption fails.
